newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CHILLERS SEALS ACQUISITION OF MASTER MEAT.
newsitem.headline: CHILLERS SEALS ACQUISITION OF MASTER MEAT.

text.p: Chillers Group Ltd said on Wednesday that the conditions precedent had been fulfilled and it had now acquired Master Meat CC.

Chillers announced the acquisition on June 10. It will acquire Master Meat for 3.5 million rand to be settled by the issue of 2.19 million ordinary shares at 96 cents each with the balance paid for by the issue of shares at 100 cents in various tranches.
The transaction is effective from March 1, 1997.
